lines.rookie:
Detective,
Last night the lamps did not go out on their own.
One of the two strangers came into the lamp house.
He did not touch the fire. He did not touch the coal.
He took off the long leather belt that turns the big wheel.
I put it back at dawn. His muddy hand is still on it.
lines.junior:
Detective,
The lamps did not go out by themselves last night.
One of the two strangers slipped into the lamp house.
He did not touch the fire. He did not touch the coal either.
He took off the long leather belt that turns the big wheel.
I put it back at dawn. His muddy handprint is still on it.
lines.master:
Detective,
The lamps did not go out by accident last night.
One of the two strangers crept into the lamp house.
He did not touch the fire. He did not touch the coal.
He took off the long leather belt that drives the big wheel.
I fitted it back at dawn. The print of his muddy hand remains on it.

lines.master: The square with the X and the wheel is the lamp house, not a door with a circle.

lines.master: three big dots and seven small dots

lines.rookie: a door with a circle
lines.junior: a door with a circle
lines.master: a door with a circle

lines.rookie: You show the King and Queen the board.
lines.junior: You show the King and the Queen the board.
lines.master: You show the King and the Queen the strangers' board.

lines.rookie: No names. Only lines, dots and marks.
lines.junior: No names. There are only lines, dots and marks.
lines.master: It has no names. There are only lines, dots and marks.

lines.rookie: The Queen asks, "Whose door is marked?"
lines.junior: The Queen asks, "Whose door is marked here?"
lines.master: The Queen leans in and asks, "Whose door is marked?"

lines.rookie: The board:
lines.junior: The board shows:
lines.master: What the board shows:

lines.rookie:
A line starts at the east gate.
It goes to a door with a circle.
By the circled door: three big dots and seven small dots.
Another line goes to a far door. By it: five big dots and two small dots. No circle.
By the pond is a square with an X. A wheel is drawn in the square.
The dots count like the knots on the rope.
lines.junior:

It goes to a door with a circle.
By the circled door: three big dots and seven small dots.
Another line goes to a far door. By it: five big dots and two small dots. No circle.

The dots count just like the knots on the rope.
lines.master:
A line starts at the east gate.
It goes to a door with a circle.
By the circled door are three big dots and seven small dots.
Another line goes to a far door. By it: five big dots and two small dots. No circle.
By the pond is a square with an X. A wheel is drawn in the square.
The dots count just like the knots on the rope.

lines.rookie: Whose door has the circle? Tap it.
lines.junior: Whose door has the circle? Tap its picture.
lines.master: Whose door have the strangers circled? Tap its picture.

lines.rookie: Big dot: ten steps. Small dot: one step.
lines.junior: A big dot is ten steps. A small dot is one step.
lines.master: As on the rope, a big dot is ten steps. A small dot is one step.

lines.rookie: Your rope measured 37 steps from the east gate. To whose door?
lines.junior: Your rope measured 37 steps from the east gate. To whose door?
lines.master: Your rope measured 37 steps from the east gate. To whose door did it lead?

lines.rookie: The circle is the Queen's door: 37 steps from the east gate!
lines.junior: The circle marks the Queen's door, 37 steps from the east gate!
lines.master: The circle marks the Queen's own door, 37 steps from the east gate!

lines.rookie: The King says, "X is the lamp house."
lines.junior: The King says, "The X is the lamp house."
lines.master: The King says, "The X is the lamp house. They plan more dark."

lines.rookie: Lady Han says, "Japan wants more power here. The Queen works with Russia."
lines.junior: Lady Han says, "Japan wants more power here. The Queen works with Russia."
lines.master: Lady Han explains, "Japan wants more power here. The Queen works with Russia to stop it."

lines.rookie: "Some men want to stop her."
lines.junior: "So some men want to stop her."
lines.master: "That is why some men want to stop her."

lines.rookie: The King folds the map.
lines.junior: Slowly, the King folds the map.
lines.master: The King folds the map slowly and quietly.

lines.rookie: They are watching me.
lines.junior: Now they are watching me.
lines.master: So now I know they are watching me.
